about: Titles written by hand where the generated name files have none or a wrong one. They take precedence over data/names/*.json when the data is bundled. Spanish follows the style of data/names/es.json (San, Santa and Santos in full; the category in lower case). Latin is in the form of a title, in the genitive or with 'In', spelt as data/names/la.json spells it. The Spanish is to be read through by a reviewer who knows the 1962 calendar. dayHeadings gives the title of the day where the celebration's key is also the key of one of its Masses.

the-nativity-of-our-lord.why: Christmas has three Masses; the key of the day is that of the Mass in the night.
